description: List stockable (inventory) items with the context needed to set opening inventory and reorder policy: item id, SKU, primary UPC, cost, default vendor, a per-warehouse breakdown of current on-hand, committed (units held by open sales and transfer orders, as Shopify counts committed), available (net of committed, as the Inventory page shows it), and reorder point / restock qty / safety stock (null where no policy row exists yet), and any custom field values set on the item (see list_custom_fields, entity=item). Optionally filter by a SKU/name search substring and/or a single warehouse. Set includeAttributes=true to also get each item's built-in attributes (dimensions, weight, carton quantity, tags, preferred bin, tax, flags), named as the upsert_items fields that write them. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500 per call.

includeAttributes.description: true = also return each item's built-in attributes (see upsert_items). Default false keeps the page small.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset for paging through the catalog (default 0).

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against SKU or name.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) to scope the on-hand and reorder-point columns to a single warehouse.

name: list_items
title: List Items
